# Future Music Collective

> Music, games, advocacy, and free browser tools at https://futuremusic.online

## Tools

- [Random Number Generator](https://futuremusic.online/numgen): Free bulk random number generator. Default output is 1,000 ten-digit numbers, comma-separated, generated in the browser. Supports custom count (1–10,000), digit length (1–18), min–max range, unique values, copy, and download. Also known as a number generator, 10-digit number generator, and random number picker.
